request: Analyze GSE289091 for PMID 41126185 (Lamin A/C protects chromatin accessibility during mechanical loading in human skeletal muscle.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of immortalized human myotubes (clone 8220), DRAGEN mapping to hg38 + GENCODE v37 quantification
final.primary_estimand: effect of acute mechanical stretch (in vitro exercise mimic) on gene expression, within each genotype: S-Ctl vs Ctl and S-siLMNA vs siLMNA
planned_contrasts: S-Ctl vs Ctl (Fig. 6d, S3.3.p3; paper: 7 DEGs)
S-siLMNA vs siLMNA (Fig. 6e, S3.3.p3; paper: 634 DEGs = 485 up / 149 down)
non_exercise_contrasts_not_run: siLMNA vs Ctl static (Fig. 3a; 876 DEGs, 446 up / 430 down)
final.sample_inclusion: n = 4 to 9 samples/group (S2.6.p1); exact samples per comparison not stated
final.normalization: edgeR CPM; keep genes with CPM > 1 in at least 2 samples (S2.6.p3)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.34 GLM likelihood ratio test, BH FDR (S2.6.p3)

paper_threshold.source_locator: FIG6 legend d,e (stretch DEGs); S2.6.p3 states |log2FC| > 1 globally

final.paper_results: Ctl stretch: 7 DEGs; siLMNA stretch: 485 up, 149 down; up genes in cytokine activity, ECM, adhesion; down in HDAC, DNA methylation, contractile fibre; concordant up DEG+DAR: HMGA2, TIMP3, HAS1, COL8A1, PAWR, EMP1; down: CKMT2 (S3.3.p4)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Abstract (ABS.p2) frames the stretch as 'mechanical stress mimicking acute muscle exercise'. The exercise-like estimand is stretch vs static within genotype (Fig. 6d,e; S3.3.p3). Methods S2.6.p3 give DESeq2 LRT with CPM>1-in-2 filter and |log2FC|>1 & FDR<0.05, but the Fig. 6 legend for the stretch DEG volcano plots states log2FC > 0.5 & FDR < 0.05; the figure-specific rule is taken as the paper threshold for these contrasts and the methods rule is kept as an audit threshold.

checks: S10.p1 names GSE289091 as the RNA-seq dataset
18 GSM samples: myotubes, siControl/siLaminsA/C, static/stretch, Hours72
DRAGEN/GENCODE v37 processing in data_processing matches S2.6.p3

ownership.reasoning: The paper's data availability statement (S10.p1) names GSE289091 for RNA-seq; sample titles carry the paper's genotype x stretch design.

exclude_samples.GSM8783562: labelled siControl stretch rep1 (library Sctrl3), but LMNA expression is at knockdown level (CPM 249 vs 801-874 in the other six siControl samples; 184-219 in run-1 siLMNA) and its expression profile correlates best with the run-1 siLMNA static samples (r 0.992-0.993 vs 0.978-0.981 with siControl); genotype label is not trustworthy

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns are GSM ids from the merged per-sample quant files, so the metadata index aligns exactly. Genotype and loading come from the title, sequencing run (run1 NovaSeq GPL24676 / run2 NextSeq GPL21697) from the description field. One sample excluded as a genotype labelling problem (LMNA knockdown check).

final.source: NumReads column of DRAGEN quant.genes.sf (Salmon-format) per sample, merged by prep_merge_quant.py

matrix.reasoning: Non-negative values, 93% integer with fractional remainder typical of EM-estimated counts; library sizes 27-48 M, matching ~44 M reads/sample in S2.6.p3. Estimated counts are rounded for DESeq2, as DESeq2 users do with Salmon NumReads.

candidates.reason_rejected: not tested in the paper; the Ctl stretch contrast lies wholly in run 1 and the siLMNA stretch contrast wholly in run 2, so an interaction would also absorb any batch-by-stretch difference

design.reasoning: Paper compares stretched to static myotubes separately within each genotype (Fig. 6d,e). Genotype is a stratum; loading is the factor. Run (sequencing batch) is a covariate candidate because siLMNA static samples span both runs.

covariates.name: run
covariates.disposition: handled by restricting the primary siLMNA contrast to run 2 (all four stretched siLMNA samples are run 2); sensitivity runs use all seven static siLMNA samples with and without a run term. Not needed for Ctl (all Ctl samples are run 1).

covariance.reasoning: Sequencing run 1 (NovaSeq) vs run 2 (NextSeq) is a strong batch: run-1 and run-2 static siLMNA samples correlate at r ~0.97 vs ~0.996 within run 2. Stretched siLMNA samples are all run 2, so pooling all static siLMNA without adjustment would partly confound stretch with run. The paper does not mention batch handling.

final.method: DESeq2 (R) LRT, full ~ cond vs reduced ~ 1, per genotype

paper_route.method: DESeq2 GLM likelihood ratio test after CPM>1-in-2 filter

deviations: siLMNA primary restricted to run 2 for batch reasons (paper sample set unknown)
filter rule implemented as CPM >= 1 (paper: > 1) in >= 2 samples of each comparison's samples

method.reasoning: Paper used DESeq2 LRT (S2.6.p3); R DESeq2 is available through tools.r_de_tools. Estimated counts are rounded (round_estimated_counts).

final.deviation_note: Fig. 6 legend (stretch DEGs) states log2FC > 0.5 & FDR < 0.05; Methods S2.6.p3 state |log2FC| > 1 & FDR < 0.05. Applied = figure rule; audit = methods rule.

threshold.reasoning: Figure-specific rule for the stretch contrasts; methods rule reported alongside because the paper is internally inconsistent.

caveats: GSM8783562 excluded as a likely genotype mislabel (LMNA at knockdown level)
Paper's exact sample sets and batch handling are not stated; the siLMNA primary uses run 2 only
Paper threshold is internally inconsistent (Fig. 6: 0.5; Methods: 1)
In vitro stretch of myotubes is an exercise mimic, not exercise in people

study.reasoning: Counts from S3.3.p3 and genes from S3.3.p4 (CKMT2 down, the others up).

discrepancies.paper: Methods: |log2FC| > 1 & FDR < 0.05; Fig. 6 legend: log2FC > 0.5 & FDR < 0.05

discrepancies.data: LMNA expression at siLMNA level; profile clusters with run-1 siLMNA static
two sequencing runs on different instruments; siLMNA stretch only in run 2
added to GEO Aug 2025, molecule polyA RNA vs total RNA for others; profile concordant with other siControl (r 0.989-0.996)

executions.name: ctl_stretch
executions.reasoning: S-Ctl vs Ctl (Fig. 6d); 3 static vs 3 stretch, all run 1.

executions.name: silmna_stretch_run2
executions.reasoning: S-siLMNA vs siLMNA (Fig. 6e) within sequencing run 2: 4 static vs 4 stretch, free of the run batch.

executions.name: silmna_stretch_all_runadj
executions.reasoning: All 7 static vs 4 stretch siLMNA with a run term.

executions.name: silmna_stretch_all_naive
executions.reasoning: All siLMNA samples without batch adjustment, the likely paper sample set; partly confounded with run, reported only for comparison with the paper's count.
